name: Aasimar
description: Aasimar are mortals who carry a spark of the Upper Planes within their souls.
traits:
Aasimar Traits
Celestial Resistance, Darkvision, Healing Hands, Light Bearer, Celestial Revelation

name: Dragonborn
description: The ancestors of dragonborn hatched from the eggs of chromatic and metallic dragons.
traits:
Dragonborn Traits
Dragon Ancestry, Breath Weapon, Damage Resistance, Darkvision, Draconic Flight

name: Dwarf
description: Dwarves were raised from the earth in the elder days by a deity of the forge.
traits:
Dwarf Traits
Darkvision, Dwarven Resilience, Dwarven Toughness, Stonecunning

name: Elf
description: The elves’ curiosity led many of them to explore other planes of existence.
traits:
Elf Traits
Darkvision, Elven Lineage, Fey Ancestry, Keen Senses, Trance

name: Gnome
description: Gnomes are magical folk created by gods of invention, illusions, and life underground.
traits:
Gnome Traits
Darkvision, Gnomish Cunning, Gnomish Lineage

name: Goliath
description: Goliaths are distant descendants of giants and seek heights above those reached by their ancestors.
traits:
Goliath Traits
Giant Ancestry, Large Form, Powerful Build

name: Halfling
description: Halflings possess a brave and adventurous spirit that leads them on journeys of discovery.
traits:
Halfling Traits
Brave, Halfling Nimbleness, Luck, Naturally Stealthy

name: Human
description: Found throughout the multiverse, humans are as varied as they are numerous.

name: Orc
description: Orcs are equipped with gifts to help them wander great plains, vast caverns, and churning seas.
traits:
Orc Traits
Adrenaline Rush, Darkvision, Relentless Endurance

name: Tiefling
description: Tieflings are either born in the Lower Planes or have fiendish ancestors who originated there.
traits:
Tiefling Traits
Darkvision, Fiendish Legacy, Otherworldly Presence
